name: Screen Entity (LEIE + OFAC + SAM)
description: Screen one individual or entity against LEIE (OIG exclusion), OFAC SDN (Treasury sanctions), and SAM.gov (federal contractor exclusion). Returns risk level (CLEAR | POTENTIAL | MATCH) plus match details. [See the documentation](https://rapidapi.com/josh-BN5mWmPiY/api/federal-exclusion-sanctions-screener/playground/apiendpoint_a5a2ef54-9557-4a97-a8e0-b6c2d36080af)
